title: Dexippus(?), Scythica Vindobonensia: new palimpsest fragments (Vind. hist. gr. 73); «Скифика» Дексиппа, венские фрагменты
author: P. Herennius Dexippus (attribution debated)
genre: Classicizing military history (Gothic wars of the 250s–260s)
edition: Martin & Grusková, GRBS 54.4 (2014): Greek text plus English, CC BY. Later leaves in other journals; Empire in Crisis (OAPEN, open access)
ru_evidence: A Russian search ('Дексипп венский палимпсест перевод') found nothing. Old fragments only in Destunis 1860 (ru.wikipedia, Дексипп (историк))
en_evidence: GRBS 2014 article includes an English translation (checked in the PDF). Other leaves are translated in scattered studies
other_translations: German and Italian scholarship (Martin; Mecella 2013 covers the old fragments)
value: One of the most important newly discovered Greek historical texts: Decius' Gothic war and the sieges of Balkan cities. Relevant to Black Sea and Gothic studies, and has no Russian at all.
ai_feasibility: Medium: a gappy text with editorial supplements. The AI must not fill gaps, which makes it a good showcase for visible review
pilot_unit: The GRBS 2014 fragment set, c. 2–3k words, with a CC BY source text
